data.action: 坐在天台长椅边缘轻轻哼唱旋律
data.description: 【杏山和纱 · 天台微风与专属旋律】黄昏染红的教学楼天台上，和纱独自坐在长椅边缘，轻轻哼唱着新谱写的旋律。黑发被晚风轻柔拂起，粉瞳在夕阳下泛着温柔的波光。察觉到你的脚步声，她回过头露出淡淡的浅笑——「……你来啦，老师。这首曲子……其实是想着你写出来的，听听看吧。」
data.promptProse: Kazusa sits at the edge of a rooftop bench, quietly humming a new melody before turning at the teacher's approaching footsteps with a faint smile. Her Trinity uniform and cat-ear-shaped hood move gently in the evening breeze. The medium view includes the bench edge under her and school buildings beyond the railing. Golden sunset backlight outlines her dark hair and shoulders, with reflected sky light keeping her expression visible.
data.title: 杏山和纱 · 天台微风与专属旋律
